The warm-up time before firing of Tyrant has been reduced
Each map has its own background music now

notes.title: Confidential Information - Mechs
notes.content:
Lv 1 - Mechs

    http://i.imgur.com/ACqcmQ6.png 
     ( Explorer )
      It's the most-used mech and which has an average ability. You can get it cheap and reform it easily. It has the most evolvements.

    http://i.imgur.com/ZWYy8XX.png
     ( Machine Cannon )
     For observing the battlefield. Instead of having lots of armor and causing huge damage of each attack, it has super fast shooting speed which makes enemies under heavy fire.
 
    http://i.imgur.com/yB2NneX.png
     ( Snipe Cannon )
       With specially made cannon and lengthened cannon barrel, it can create destructive damage and have good shooting range. However, the loss of lots of health points makes it harder to survive.

    http://i.imgur.com/YDRlKGX.png
     ( Iron Thorn )
       Its extremely hard armor is its mech. It destroys its target by colliding it. Also, it has lots of health points which let it bear attacks for your alliance.


Lv 2 - Mechs

    http://i.imgur.com/yRDQ04b.png 
     ( Three Claws )
       Evolved from Machine Cannon. It is reformed to have bigger and further shooting range instead of fast speed. It is usually used in guerrilla.

    http://i.imgur.com/1xTvwvy.png
     ( Intensified Automatic Cannon )
       Evolved form Machine Cannon. Its light Automatic Gun is reformed to make it more threatening. However, its low health points makes it hard to overpower the battlefield.

    http://i.imgur.com/Dmj2QGy.png
     ( Missile )
       Evolved from Machine Cannon. By putting the tracking device in the cannon, it automatically tracks down and kill the enemies. Everyone can't avoid its attack once it gets tracked.

    http://i.imgur.com/YDPH1hU.png
     ( Heavy Snipe )
       Evolved from Snipe Cannon. By reforming a lot of it, you enhance its destructive power and it can kill enemies immediately. The damage it creates gets relatively higher according to the distance. In another word, it means if the target is further, it gets stronger damage. However, its weakness is it takes too long to change its clip.

    http://i.imgur.com/ByTzbFx.png
     ( Light Snipe )
       Evolved from Snipe Cannon. Though you can't launch an extremely strong attack, you can attack the enemies faster and make them not to approach you so easily.

    http://i.imgur.com/lKJbyYE.png
     ( Fire Cannon )
       Evolved from the Explorer. It gets the destructive burning ability by decreasing the damage of its basic attack.  It's especially for interrupting the target to recover.

    http://i.imgur.com/kl5mUNi.png
     ( Freeze Cannon )
       Evolved from Explorer. Once shooting the target, it slows down the targets by the chill. Another feature is that you can absorb the chill back and turn it into cannon.

    http://i.imgur.com/ibXHLJM.png 
     ( Shot Cannon )
       Evolved from Explorer. It is designed to shoot enemies near you. A single cannon doesn't harm much; however, if it shots the enemies in a relatively close distance, it cause lots of harm.

    http://i.imgur.com/htGg9gi.png
     ( Shock Cannon )
       Evolved from the Explorer. After reforming the cannon, it destroys enemies by its shock wave after hitting the target. It's famous of its wide range of shock wave.

    http://i.imgur.com/s6RLuRG.png
     ( Beam Laser )
       Evolved from Iron Thorn. By exchanging many health points to get higher speed. You can approach the enemies and kill them without making any nois.

    http://i.imgur.com/DcqoDqu.png 
     ( Mad Bull )
       Evolved from Iron Thorn. It has higher health points and equipped with injection device. It moves fast and can kill its target without missing.

    http://i.imgur.com/q3nl9rw.png
     ( Titan )
       Evolved from Iron Thorn. Its extremely high health points makes it unbreakable. When it moves, it looks like a big castle moving which is impossible for it to get hurt. When it attacks, it adds more armors and accelerates its speed temporarily.


Lv 3 - Mechs

    http://i.imgur.com/U7pvGlx.png
     ( The Out of Controlled )
       Evolved from Intensified Automatic Cannon. Its special cannons sabotage enemies' shooting system to slow them down. It slows down fast-shooting enemies and destroys their abilities. It's very horrifying.

    http://i.imgur.com/a0cSpUU.png
     ( Tyrant )
       Evolved from Intensified Automatic Cannon. It takes time to prepare for shooting, but it has extremely strong destructive power. It has lots of clips, so it attacks enemies like a destructive tornado. However, once it starts shooting, you can't move which tests your judgement.

    http://i.imgur.com/iMy7szq.png 
     ( Curse )
       Evolved from the Three Claw. By putting corrosive substance in the cannon, it corrodes enemies' armors to create more harm.

    http://i.imgur.com/ZW6OYc8.png 
     ( Beast Claws )
       Evolved from Three Claws. It has extra two guns which make it shoot faster and further, and it's special cannon makes greater damage as well. It tears apart its target on the battlefield like a beast.

    http://i.imgur.com/CTUe73r.png 
     ( Follower )
       Evolved from Missile. It's reformed gun allows it to shoot more missiles. However, the reformation weakens its other abilities.

    http://i.imgur.com/9tsv3F0.png
     ( Female Warrior  )
       Evolved from Heavy Snipe. It can destroy most of the targets in a second with just one shot. However, it takes long to change its clip like Heavy Snipe.

    http://i.imgur.com/Sf7CDel.png 
     ( Destroyer )
       Evolved from Heavy Snipe. It's shooing range and destructive attack seem infinite. It takes longer to prepare an attack once you have higher speed and attack power which depends on your judgement.

    http://i.imgur.com/SxAa0la.png 
     ( Shadow )
       Especially reformed from Heavy Snipe. It has a special armor that changes like a chameleon, so it can move without getting caught. However, when you launch an attack or use your skill, the power will be overloaded and the armor will be turned off.

    http://i.imgur.com/BfnBrGd.png 
     ( Soultaker )
       Especially reformed from Light Snipe. It has better shooting range and still keeps good health points, so you can have better chance to survive. Also, it has a magnet, so it can get the target towards it with magnetic force.

    http://i.imgur.com/mMFxj6L.png 
     ( Punturer )
       Evolved from Light Snipe. You can hide behind anything and make an unexpected attack since the cannon can run through anything.

    http://i.imgur.com/S8nIkLZ.png
     ( Fire Dragon )
       Evolved from Fire Cannon. It slows its shooting speed, but it burns longer and causes more damage. It shoots targets more easily by expanding radius of cannons.

    http://i.imgur.com/R2t4VVx.png 
     ( Fire Serpent )
       Evolved from Fire Cannon. It enhances its shooting speed and range. Though it doesn't create much damage, it makes enemies under great fear of getting burned. It can restrain enemies from getting closer.

    http://i.imgur.com/qLBlmVl.png
     ( Ice Dragon )
       Evolved from Freeze Cannon. It's the only mech which can self-explode. After hitting enemies triple times, it automatically self-explodes to make a faster attack.

    http://i.imgur.com/8kqKSrg.png
     ( Electric Beast )
       Evolved from Shot Cannon. Its extra guns makes its shooting range very wide and almost won't miss any. However, it can't make big damage and it has fewer health points, so it's usually used to restrain enemies from far away.

    http://i.imgur.com/rntbSTe.png
     ( Sakura )
       Evolved from Shot Cannon. It makes greater damage in close distance than the original. It is used to shoot mechs around. It can be as fierce as Gigantic if it has good hit rate.

    http://i.imgur.com/5JRuzro.png 
     ( Thunderbolt )
       Evolved from Shock Cannon. By putting a special device in the cannons, it can make electromagnetic wave to hurt and paralyze enemies for a few seconds. It plays several roles on the battlefield.

    http://i.imgur.com/gwZiEuU.png
     ( Shadow Warrior )
       Evolved from Beam Laser. It's extremely fast speed makes it earn the name "the shadow warrior on the battlefield". It is good at launching unexpected attacks.

    http://i.imgur.com/bwOc9xl.png
     ( Fury of the Terra )
       Evolved from Mad Bull. It has high health points and once it hits its target, it hurts the enemies in the area with its shockwave.

    http://i.imgur.com/Evf07Ck.png
     ( Gigantic )
       Evolved from Mad Bull. Not only does it have high health points, it releases pulse wave that paralyzes enemies from behind.

    http://i.imgur.com/4vUvJO8.png
     ( Immortal )
       Reformed from Titan. It is made of a special and forbidden material to make has the ability to recover itself from damage. It can recover itself completely once after damaged. It is also known as "the undead on battlefield".

    http://i.imgur.com/v6FgjI1.png
     ( Iron Guard )
       Evolved from Titan. It has a special force field to defend all long distance attacks. It is used to protect your alliance. However, be aware that it can't defend short-distance attacks or special attack.
